Author: Jagdish Prasad Gupta Bench: Jagdish Prasad Gupta  1 MCRC-41516-  The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh  MCRC-41516-2019  (ANIK MILK PRODUCTS PVT. LTD. Vs THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH)
1 Jabalpur, Dated : 04-10-2019  Shri Siddharth Gupta, Advocate for the applicant.
 Shri R.N.Yadav, P.L. for the respondent/State.
Heard on I.A.No.18728/2019 which is an application for taking additional facts and documents on record.

entities.text: High Court Of Madhya Pradesh  MCRC-41516-2019
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: For the reasons stated in the application, this application is allowed.
Additional facts and documents are taken on record.

Heard on admission as well as I.A.No.18553/2019 which is an application for restraining the arrest of the Officers of the petitioner Company vide Crime No.397/2019 registered at Police Station Sohagpur, District Hoshangabad.

Learned counsel for the applicant submits that in view of the provisions of sections 42 and 43 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, the prosecution can be launched on the direction of the Commissioner on complaint under the Food Safety and Standard Act.
It is further submitted that so far as other offences under sections 417, 272 and 420 of the I.P.C. are concerned, prima facie they are not made out from the FIR.
As there is no cognizable offence, hence, no FIR can be lodged and no investigation can be made.

Having heard learned counsel for the applicant, without commenting anything on the merit of the case, in view of this Court, prima facie, the contentions advanced by learned counsel for the applicant have substance.
Therefore, the police authorities are directed not to take any coercive action against the officers of the petitioner company till next date of hearing.
